exposure: Early (<6 weeks) vs. late (6 weeks to 9 months postpartum) maternal readmission with sepsis
cohort: 1,880,264 women who gave birth in California from 2008 to 2011
finding: Preterm birth, hemorrhage, obesity, government-provided insurance, and primary cesarean were identified as risk factors for both early and late maternal readmission with sepsis.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a risk factor for both early and late maternal readmission with sepsis.
